domain: chat reliability, unified observability, credential management, three-tab UX
summary: Introduced TriosLogBus as the single source of truth for in-app events, added multi-key credential management, and fixed three concrete Z.AI defects that made chat fail silently and the Test button lie.

root_causes.finding: 225 NSLog call sites across 29 Swift files went to the macOS unified log, while LogParser.loadLogSources only read .trinity/*.log. The app's own events were invisible in the app's own LOGS tab.
root_causes.fix: rings/SR-01/TriosLogBus.swift writes OTel-shaped NDJSON to .trinity/logs/trios-app.jsonl, tagged by subsystem, with a bounded ring buffer and an NSLog mirror.

root_causes.finding: ModelCredentialStore keyed Keychain items by provider.rawValue alone, so save() deleted the previous key. One key per provider, no list, no per-key delete.
root_causes.fix: Accounts are now provider#uuid with kSecAttrLabel for the user label; list/add/delete/rename/activate operate per entry, and the legacy bare-provider account still resolves.

root_causes.finding: makeChatURL appended /v1/chat/completions to a Z.AI base URL that already ended in /api/paas/v4, producing /v4/v1/chat/completions. Verified HTTP 404 live. Every Z.AI health probe failed regardless of key or balance.
root_causes.fix: Z.AI now shares the OpenAI path case (/chat/completions).

root_causes.finding: Key validation for Z.AI hit GET /models, which answers HTTP 200 for a key with zero balance, so Test reported a green 'Key valid' while every completion failed with business code 1113.
root_causes.fix: After the 200, a minimal completion probe runs; ZAIErrorParser classifies code 1113 as exhausted and the result carries a balanceWarning and a depleted quota.

root_causes.finding: probeCloud discarded the response body, so a Z.AI 429 carrying code 1113 was classified as a retryable rate limit. A permanently failing request was retried.
root_causes.fix: The body is read and parsed; balance exhaustion returns failureKind .balance with no Retry-After.

root_causes.finding: A2A registration failure always blamed startup timing. The registry was actually up (GET /a2a/agents -> 200) and rejecting with 403 Local authorization required; the caught error was never shown.
root_causes.fix: a2aRegistrationFailureMessage names the real cause per status, and repeated banners are deduplicated.

lessons.lesson: Reading modelStore from inside ChatViewModel.sendMessage perturbs the streaming turn. Adding provider/model attributes to a log call there broke two ChatSSEEndToEnd assertions (message count became 3 instead of 2).
lessons.how_to_apply: Log only text-derived facts in the send hot path. Record provider and model from routing and transport events instead. Bisect by reverting the single suspect edit and rebuilding - it cost one build cycle and gave a definitive answer.

lessons.lesson: Piping build.sh through grep masks its exit code, so a failed build can look like a pass.
lessons.how_to_apply: Redirect to a file and check $? directly: ./build.sh > /tmp/build.txt 2>&1; echo $?

lessons.lesson: The working tree dropped ~19 files out of rings/SR-00 mid-build and restored them within seconds, twice. git status alternated between M and D for the same paths. clade-monitor only removes its own pidfile, and build.sh never deletes sources, so neither is the cause.
lessons.how_to_apply: Back up edited and new files to /tmp before rebuilding, then poll until git status reports zero deletions for several consecutive samples before trusting a build result.

lessons.lesson: An unknown model's price should stay nil rather than be guessed. ModelCostService.cost returns an Optional and callers already handle nil.
lessons.how_to_apply: glm-5.2 was added to the model list and context profiles but deliberately left out of the cost table until real pricing is known.

verification.build_sh: exit 0, zero errors, zero test failures
verification.clade_e2e: 5/5 Swift logic suites passed (ChatLogic, OpenRouterCreditsParser, ZAIErrorParser, TriosLogBus, LogParserTriosApp); server OK; app running
verification.cargo: cargo check and cargo clippy clean for clade-e2e
verification.live_probes: GET /api/paas/v4/models -> 200; POST /api/paas/v4/chat/completions -> 429 code 1113 for every model incl. glm-5.2; POST /api/paas/v4/v1/chat/completions -> 404 (the old buggy path); GET /a2a/agents -> 200; POST /a2a/register -> 403
verification.blocked: Post-ASCII-cleanup re-verification could not run: swiftc became blocked mid-session by the Xcode license agreement, which requires a sudo password. Last green run predates a two-character ASCII fix in one string literal and one comment.

known_gaps: The chat 'Failed after 3 attempts' retry loop lives in the BrowserOS Node agent, not in trios, so the client-side terminal-error classification does not stop it yet.
browseros-companion.log carries a postgres auth failure every 30 seconds from the stale-lease reclaimer, which is the bulk of its 207 errors and is server-side.
glm-5.2 has no entry in ModelCostService, so cost-aware ranking cannot score it.
Per-key health and quota tracking is not implemented; a depleted key is not yet distinguishable per entry in the list.
